_comment: Runtime configuration for the review pipeline. The Lambda reads this file from the input bucket (key: config.json) on each run. Edit it in S3 to change behavior without redeploying. 'default_model' must be one of the ids under 'models'. 'debug' toggles verbose debug logging (CloudWatch).

models.label: Claude Haiku 5.5 (US inference profile) — default
models.notes: Current fast/efficient Claude Haiku. bedrock-runtime requires a geo/global inference profile id; this is the US geo profile.

models.label: Claude Haiku 5.5 (global inference profile)
models.notes: Same model, routed globally. Use when single-region data residency is not required.

models.label: Amazon Nova 2 Lite (US inference profile)
models.notes: Low-cost Amazon text model. Like Claude, bedrock-runtime needs the geo inference profile id (us. prefix). The Bedrock client auto-detects Nova and uses the Nova messages/inferenceConfig schema. Ensure model access is enabled.
